exposure: Deliveries with and without known risk factors for clavicle fracture
cohort: Singleton, live-born newborns born spontaneously or by vacuum-assisted delivery, in cephalic presentation ≥37(+0) weeks of gestation in Finland between 2004 and 2017
finding: The incidence of clavicle fractures decreased between 2004-2010 and 2011-2017, despite stable or increased incidence of most risk factors and a stable cesarean birth rate.
mod_finding: The cesarean birth rate remained stable, although the rate of vacuum-assisted deliveries increased.
birth_weight: All birthweights included, with specific analysis on birthweight ≥4000 g
